title: Battery thermal management
text: A battery system comprising a temperature sensor and a cooling controller configured to regulate coolant flow based on cell temperature.

title: Robot grasp planning
text: A robotic arm comprising a camera and a processor configured to detect an object and determine a grasp position from an image.

title: Semantic document retrieval
text: A search system that encodes a query and document claims into vector representations and ranks documents according to vector similarity.

title: Network anomaly detection
text: A network monitoring system that detects anomalous packet traffic using a trained machine learning classifier.

title: Data schema validation
text: A data ingestion system configured to validate record field types against a schema and quarantine incompatible records before storage.

title: Solar power forecasting
text: A method of forecasting solar energy output based on historical power measurements and weather observations.

title: Image-based disease detection
text: An image processing system using a neural network to classify medical images and identify regions associated with disease.

title: Secure payment processing
text: A transaction system that tokenizes payment credentials and verifies authorization before completing a purchase.

title: Vehicle route planning
text: An autonomous vehicle controller that computes a route using obstacle positions derived from camera images and range sensors.

title: Inventory demand forecasting
text: A method of predicting inventory demand from historical orders and time series sales data.
